journey.name: Signed-out tablet launch and authentication entry
journey.description: Verify that the full PodTrackio APK launches on an expanded Android tablet viewport with real product branding and exposes both Supabase OAuth entry points without crashing.

actions.action: Verify that Android asks whether PodTrackio may send notifications
Verify that the PodTrackio welcome screen is visible
Verify that the real PodTrackio logo and the "PodTrackio" wordmark are visible
Verify that the old headphone and "PT" placeholder branding are absent
Verify that the learning-continuity explanation mentions macOS and Android
Verify that the "Continue with Google" button is visible
Verify that the "Continue with Apple" button is visible
Verify that the app process remains alive with no PodTrackio fatal exception
